557:t_036:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
「It's a promise, $$宗介$$! Make sure you come back, no matter what!」

557:t_037:1.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, return at once! Ignore the remaining enemies!」

557:t_037:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Hurry and recover the ground forces and the enemy soldiers who surrendered, too!」

557:t_037:3.en:
$$宗介$$
($$レナード・テスタロッサ$$... You had power like that, so why could you only go about it that way...)

557:t_037:4.en:
$$宗介$$
(A man like you could have found some other way...)

557:t_037:5.en:
$$宗介$$
(What a rotten feeling. Now that you're dead, the things I want to say to you keep coming to me one after another...)

557:t_037:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「But right now...! I'm going after the Major!」

557:t_038:0.en:
$$アル$$
「Welcome back, Sergeant. I am delighted to see you have returned safely.」

557:t_038:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「They left you behind too, huh.」

557:t_038:2.en:
$$アル$$
「I am immobilized and on the verge of being scrapped, after all. Judging by tactical merit, it was a natural decision.」

557:t_038:3.en:
$$アル$$
「For my part, I would very much like to lodge an objection, however.」

557:t_038:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「You never stop talking back, right to the end.」

557:t_038:6.en:
$$アル$$
「They have already evacuated over the Pacific Ocean.」

557:t_038:9.en:
$$宗介$$
(I can't tell whether it meant 'go' or 'live', but I feel like I've heard it somewhere before...)

557:t_038:10.en:
$$アル$$
「Are you not going to flee, Sergeant?」

557:t_038:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Flee where? According to $$レナード$$, this $$第３新東京市$$ site will definitely get caught up in the $$時空震動弾|lc$$.」

557:t_038:12.en:
$$アル$$
「It is regrettable that you, Sergeant, do not have a $$ブーストアップ$$ like $n's.」

557:t_038:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$n, huh... I hope he got $$千鳥$$ there safely...」

557:t_038:14.en:
$$宗介$$
「Oh, well... I'll settle for having gotten to see them one last time.」

557:t_038:15.en:
$$アル$$
「I too will settle for having repaid that cheater for what I owed him at $$陣代高校$$.」

557:t_038:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$レナード$$'s $$ベリアル$$, you mean. So you held a grudge...」

557:t_038:19.en:
$$アル$$
「Data has just been sent over from $$ＡＧ$$.」

557:t_038:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「I take it this is about the $$Ｚチップ$$ and my death throes.」

557:t_038:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't feel like it, but let's take a look.」

557:t_039:4.en:
$$風間$$
「...So, that's the idea. I heard that $$兜$$ and the others, and $$相良$$ and the others, are having a hard time, so we'll send you a message by uploading it online.」

557:t_039:5.en:
$$恭子$$
「$$カナ$$-chan, $$相良$$... As you can see, I'm doing fine, so please don't worry about what happened back then at all.」

557:t_039:6.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Look... how do I put this, $$相良$$... I'm sorry I lost it on you when you came to the school to apologize...」

557:t_039:7.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I was all shaken up back then, too... Thinking about it afterward, I wondered if blaming everything on you was really right...」

557:t_039:8.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「But, you know... part of me also felt like, hey, why are you being so distant with us...」

557:t_039:9.en:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「I figure you and $$アルト$$ and the others had your reasons... But that kind of thing just feels lonely, you know...」

557:t_039:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$... I got to see something good at the very end...」

557:t_039:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't give up, $$宗介$$! Activate the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$!」

557:t_039:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's no good... $$レーバテイン$$'s $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ has already been destroyed.」

557:t_039:13.en:
$$アル$$
「Tracing your thought patterns, Sergeant, to use the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ is impossible as well.」

557:t_039:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「Thanks. But when my final moment comes, I want to meet it listening to the voices of everyone at $$陣代高校$$.」

557:t_040:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「How much time do we have left?」

557:t_041:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... I... don't want to... die...」

557:t_041:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't want to... I don't... I want to go back... to that school, with $$千鳥$$... and everyone...」

557:t_041:6.en:
$$アル$$
「Before I try one thing, there is something I would like to ask.」

557:t_041:7.en:
$$アル$$
「Am I human? Or a machine?」

557:t_041:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「...to decide for yourself. Every human... does that.」

557:t_041:13.en:
$$アル$$
「I will try it on my own.」

557:t_043:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I have a proposal, $$ベック$$.」

557:t_043:1.en:
$$ベック$$
「No matter what you say, I ain't falling for your smooth talk.」

557:t_043:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Then I will say my piece regardless. Do you not intend to stop fighting?」

557:t_043:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Setting aside your days of rampaging as you pleased, and your mercenary work for $$ファイヤバグ$$, the man you are now is not like you.」

557:t_043:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「For a small-time crook, an honest punk like you to destroy the world is far too ill-suited.」

557:t_043:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「You lookin' to pick a fight with me!?」

557:t_043:7.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「How you take it is up to you. But I cannot bear to watch an old acquaintance fall, either.」
